display_long_description:
FOOTBALL GURU is the ultimate VR penalty kick experience built for players who crave real pressure, real precision, and real skill.

Step into a packed stadium. Hear the crowd. Feel the tension. It’s just you, the ball, and the goalkeeper staring you down.

In FOOTBALL GURU, every shot is fully physics-driven and controlled by your real movement. Aim, adjust your angle, control your power, and strike naturally using intuitive VR controls. Curve it into the top corner. Smash it down the middle. Fake the keeper and slot it home with ice-cold confidence.

But this isn’t just about kicking hard.

You’ll face increasingly intelligent goalkeepers who study your patterns and adapt to your play style. Mix up your strategy. Control your nerves. Outthink the keeper before you outshoot him.

Features:

Realistic, physics-based penalty kicks

Immersive stadium environments with dynamic atmosphere

Progressive difficulty with smarter, faster goalkeepers

Score challenges and competitive leaderboards

Skill-based gameplay with no gimmicks, no randomness

Whether you’re chasing the perfect top-corner strike or grinding to dominate the leaderboard, FOOTBALL GURU rewards mastery, consistency, and mental toughness.

Pressure creates legends.

Step up. Strike true. Become the Guru.
